people.name: Isabel Tolentino
people.role: junior at Alcaraz Flats High applying to colleges
people.summary: Isabel is a Flats High junior with a 4.1 GPA who wants to study environmental engineering as far from Alcaraz Flats as she can get, ideally somewhere with snow. She fights with her mother Grace, who teaches chemistry down the hall, about essays, curfew and whether out-of-state tuition is fantasy. She writes furious, polished drafts at midnight and then can't bring herself to hit submit. She says she hates the town but volunteers every November at the marsh park counting egrets.
traits: sarcastic with family, gentle with little kids

people.name: Dulce Henríquez
people.role: sophomore at Alcaraz Flats High, part-time counter worker at Taquería Colima
people.summary: Dulce is a Flats High sophomore in Ms. Tolentino's chemistry class who just got her first job taking orders at Taquería Colima on Calle Ortega. Her friend group split in September after Brianna's breakup, and both sides expect Dulce to choose. She is proud of her first paychecks and saving for a used phone, yet spends half of each one on boba for friends. She is close to her cousin Rafael, who drives her home from late shifts.
traits: quick with numbers at the register

people.name: Linh Pham
people.role: Tamsen Valley College student, barista at Heron & Grind
people.summary: Linh is in her second year at Tamsen Valley College taking anatomy and chemistry toward a possible nursing transfer, and she pulls shots at Heron & Grind four days a week. Her older sister Thao is a night nurse, which makes nursing feel both obvious and suffocating. She keeps meticulous color-coded notes but forgets to eat lunch. She tells her mother she is sure about pharmacy when she isn't sure about anything.

people.name: Arjun Sandhu
people.role: junior in logistics management at Bayshore State, Tamsen campus
people.summary: Arjun is a logistics management junior who rides the Tule Line every morning and is applying to every supply-chain internship he can find for summer 2026. He shares a Marisol Gardens two-bedroom with Marcus. He keeps a spreadsheet of 63 applications but freezes in phone screens. He lectures his roommate about sleep while staying up until 2 a.m. tweaking his resume.

people.name: Marcus Bell
people.role: sophomore at Bayshore State, night-shift picker at Ridgeline RF-4
people.summary: Marcus is a Bayshore State sophomore studying kinesiology who works Ridgeline nights to cover rent and help his mom after her hours were cut. He sleeps from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. and attends afternoon sections half-awake. He is easygoing with everyone at work but bristles when Arjun gives advice. He spends carefully on everything except sneakers.

people.name: Rafael Henríquez
people.role: automotive technology student at Tamsen Valley College, helps run the family pupusa stand
people.summary: Rafael is in Tamsen Valley's automotive technology program and lives with his parents, working the family's Pupusería Henríquez stand Thursday to Sunday. He can diagnose a misfire by ear but struggles with the written ASE practice tests. He wants to open his own shop someday yet feels guilty imagining leaving the stand. He is the family's unofficial driver for cousins, including Dulce.

people.name: Thao Pham
people.role: night-shift RN on 4 West at St. Anselm Valley Medical Center
people.summary: Thao works three 12-hour nights a week on 4 West at St. Anselm and is dreading the September charting go-live. She lives at Marisol Gardens unit 207, and her boyfriend Tomás moved in this October. She is unflappable at a code but lets voicemails pile up for weeks. She mothers Linh more than their actual mother does and is torn about the union vote.

people.name: Noemi Castillo
people.role: IT support technician on the Ridgeline RF-4 help desk
people.summary: Noemi fixes handheld scanners, badge readers and frozen laptops on Ridgeline's on-site IT desk, and knows half the night shift, including Marcus, by their broken devices. She is studying for a network certification on weekends. She preaches password hygiene but reuses one password for everything personal. When her lead Greg left in October she started doing his job without the title.

people.name: Jun Villanueva
people.role: barista at Heron & Grind starting a lumpia pop-up business
people.summary: Jun has worked the espresso bar at Heron & Grind for three years and is launching Lola's Roll, a lumpia pop-up with his friend Paolo using his mother's recipe. He's chasing a cottage food permit and commissary time. He is charming with customers but terrified of spreadsheets and taxes. He trains Linh on latte art and borrows her calculator brain.

people.name: Elliot Brandt
people.role: Tamsen County assessor's office analyst on parental leave
people.summary: Elliot is on 12 weeks of parental leave from the Tamsen County Assessor's Office caring for his son Theo, born in July, at Marisol Gardens unit 209 next door to Thao. His wife Hana went back to work in November, leaving him in charge of bottles, naps and laundry. He runs his household like a spreadsheet and is quietly overwhelmed when nothing goes to plan. He is a planner who has not cooked a real dinner in three months.

people.name: Rochelle Simmons
people.role: former Ridgeline picker taking nursing prerequisites at Tamsen Valley College
people.summary: Rochelle spent eight years at Ridgeline RF-4 before a back strain pushed her to quit and start nursing prerequisites at Tamsen Valley; she sits next to Linh in anatomy. Her husband Andre still drives for Ridgeline and their savings are thin. She is fearless asking questions in class but panics over online quizzes. She tells her daughter to put school first while she herself skips study group to cover family errands.

people.name: Grace Tolentino
people.role: chemistry teacher at Alcaraz Flats High
people.summary: Grace has taught chemistry at Flats High for 17 years and has Dulce in her third-period class. She is mother to Isabel and argues with her constantly over college lists and late nights. She is patient with other people's teenagers and short-fused with her own. She grades on Sundays after Tagalog Mass with her mother Corazon, who lives with them.

people.name: Ramón Tolentino
people.role: Grace's husband, Isabel's father, county fire dispatcher
people.summary: Ramón works 24-hour dispatch shifts and is the softer parent, so Isabel goes to him first. He says he trusts Isabel to choose a college but quietly sides with Grace about staying close.

people.name: Nadia Rahimi
people.role: Isabel's best friend, Flats High junior
people.summary: Nadia is Isabel's best friend and yearbook editor. She is calm in front of others but cries over every rejection email.

people.name: Corazón Dizon
people.role: Grace's mother, Isabel's grandmother, lives with the family
people.summary: Lola Cora lives in the Tolentinos' back bedroom and cooks sinigang every Sunday. She insists she's fine yet hides her glucose meter readings.

people.role: Dulce's mother, environmental services at St. Anselm
people.summary: Yesenia raises Dulce mostly alone and works day shifts cleaning at St. Anselm. She is strict about curfews but lets Dulce skip chores whenever she works at the taquería.

people.name: Brianna Ochoa
people.summary: Brianna is the center of Dulce's friend group and the center of its drama after her September breakup. She demands loyalty while trading secrets freely.

people.name: Karina Luna
people.summary: Karina is Dulce's lab partner and the friend Brianna now refuses to speak to. She acts unbothered but texts Dulce at midnight asking if people hate her.

people.summary: Oscar runs Pupusería Henríquez on top of a forklift job and dreams of a brick-and-mortar spot. He preaches saving money but just bought a $1,400 griddle.

people.name: Gladys Henríquez
people.summary: Gladys makes the masa at 4 a.m. and runs the stand's money. She worries constantly but is the one who laughs loudest at the stand.

people.summary: Tomás is a fourth-year IBEW apprentice who moved in with Thao in October. He is tidy at work and a disaster at home.
